overviewFields.title: High-Quality Digital Audio
overviewFields.value: Enhance your listening experience with the Pearl USB A-B Digital Audio Cable, designed for high-performance sound transmission. Whether you're connecting a computer to a DAC, a streamer to an amplifier, or another digital device, this cable ensures accurate, low-distortion audio playback. With cutting-edge materials and engineering, it delivers a pure signal for superior sound clarity.

overviewFields.title: Solid Long-Grain Copper Conductors for Better Performance
overviewFields.value: Unlike standard USB cables, the Pearl USB A-B cable uses solid long-grain copper conductors, which minimize distortion and reduce jitter. This results in a smoother, more natural sound, enhancing the depth and detail in your music.

overviewFields.title: High-Speed Data Transfer with Low Jitter
overviewFields.value: Engineered for precise signal timing, this cable supports high-speed USB 2.0 transmission. The advanced design reduces digital timing errors, preserving the integrity of your audio signal for a more immersive listening experience.

overviewFields.title: Noise-Dissipation System for Clean Signal Delivery
overviewFields.value: The Carbon-Based Noise-Dissipation System absorbs and deflects external interference that can degrade sound quality. By preventing RF noise from polluting the signal, this technology ensures clearer, more dynamic audio playback.

overviewFields.title: Superior Build for Long-Lasting Performance
overviewFields.value: Crafted with precision engineering, the Pearl USB A-B cable features high-quality insulation, shielding, and connectors to provide a durable, reliable connection. Designed to withstand frequent use, it maintains its performance over time.

overviewFields.title: Universal Compatibility for Seamless Connectivity
overviewFields.value: This cable is compatible with all USB Type-A to USB Type-B connections, making it ideal for connecting computers, DACs, music streamers, and other digital audio components. Whether you're a casual listener or an audiophile, this cable is designed to meet your needs.

name: JBL Quantum Stream Wireless Wearable Streaming Microphone - USB-C (Black)

overviewFields.title: Take Your Show on The Road
overviewFields.value: Record, stream, and create content from anywhere. The JBL Quantum Stream Wireless with USB-C dongle for Android and the latest Apple* devices is a versatile, agile microphone with an omnidirectional pattern that picks up high quality sound from every direction. The lightweight, clip-on design is convenient and comfortable. Yet it still delivers clear recordings with adjustable environmental noise cancelling and the optional furry windshield for windy conditions. Adjustable mic gain makes it easy to record in any environment, and a mute button with an LED indicator means you’ll never forget when you’re not on-mic. All this, plus it’s compatible with the powerful JBL Headphones app so you can fully customize how you sound. Take your show on the road with the JBL Quantum Stream Wireless.

overviewFields.title: Feature
overviewFields.value: 24 hours of recording time, plus speed charge

overviewFields.title: Feature
overviewFields.value: Customizable with the JBL Headphones App & JBL QuantumENGINE

overviewFields.title: Plug And Play
overviewFields.value: Plug the 2.4Ghz Low Latency Wireless USB-C dongle directly into your Android and the latest Apple* devices and you’re connected. It’s that simple. And feel free to move away from your device, because you have 100 meters of transmission range.

overviewFields.title: Crystal Clear Recordings
overviewFields.value: Be sure your voice will be crisp and defined despite wind and noise. The omnidirectional pick-up pattern with adjustable environmental noise cancelling allows for crips recordings with, or without, ambient sounds.

overviewFields.title: Adjustable Mic Gain
overviewFields.value: Boost or lower the volume of your voice going into the mic using the JBL Headphones app, and your recordings will sound great whether you’re recording in a library or on a football pitch.

overviewFields.title: 24 Hours of Recording Time, Plus Speed Charge
overviewFields.value: Record or broadcast wirelessly for up to 6 hours and get another 18 from the charging case. If you’re in a hurry, a quick 15-minute charge gives you 1 additional recording hour.

overviewFields.title: Customizable with the JBL Headphones App
overviewFields.value: The JBL Headphones app personalizes your recording experience just for you. Easily customize EQ, gain, noise suppression, auto-off timing, LED brightness, and more right from your Android device.

overviewFields.title: Windscreen For Noise Reduction
overviewFields.value: The optional windscreen, easy to attach on the go, allows for crystal clear outdoor recordings.

overviewFields.title: Reliable Recordings
overviewFields.value: You’ll always know when you’re connected, when you’re recording, and when the battery needs charging, all thanks to the status lights on the mic and case. You can also dim the LED lights in low-light situations using the JBL Headphones app.

overviewFields.title: Charge While Streaming
overviewFields.value: You can easily charge your device while streaming, using the additional USB-C port in the dongle.

overviewFields.title: Compatible with JBL QuantumENGINE
overviewFields.value: The JBL Quantum Stream Wireless supports the PC software JBL QuantumENGINE so you can quickly adjust EQ and gain to fine-tune your sound, mute and unmute yourself, apply noise reduction, all from your device.

While small in stature, the Nashville’s exceptional engineering provides deep bass and clear vocals for superior audio performance on the go.

overviewFields.title: Plenty Of Power For A Long Night Of Honky Tonkin’
overviewFields.value: This small-but-mighty Bluetooth speaker can last up to 24 hours on a single charge. Whether you’re traversing Music City’s streets or taking a long ride outta town, the Klipsch Nashville’s long-lasting battery has you covered.

overviewFields.title: Rugged As Blue Ridge, Smooth Like The Mississippi
overviewFields.value: Enjoy IP67 dust and waterproof rating with this travel-ready Bluetooth speaker. The Klipsch Nashville is completely protected from dust and submergible up to one meter for 30 minutes.

overviewFields.title: Best Bluetooth Connectivity Tech On The Market Today
overviewFields.value: Wireless connectivity is a must-have for your on-the-go lifestyle. That’s why the Klipsch Nashville features Bluetooth 5.3 true wireless technology for seamless stereo playback. This portable speakers remembers up to 8 devices for ultimate playlist flexibility and control.

overviewFields.title: Charged Up for The Modern World
overviewFields.value: Enjoy 18W USB-C charging for fast, effective powering while reverse USB-C charge functionality (10W) lets you pull on some of that energy in a pinch to recharge your smartphone or other mobile device.

overviewFields.title: Better With Friends: Broadcast Mode
overviewFields.value: Party people, pay attention – the Klipsch Nashville featured broadcast mode to allow playback on up to 10+ Klipsch speakers at once! Just put the desired speakers into broadcast pairing mode while audio is playing and enjoy mono signals being sent to the added devices.

overviewFields.title: Built-In Microphone for Calls
overviewFields.value: Plans change, and maybe your solo hike has turned into a group hang on Broadway Street. You won’t miss a beat with the Klipsch Nashville’s built-in microphone, allowing you to pause on your music to take a quick call, all without having to search for your cellphone first.

overviewFields.title: Klipsch Connect App Enabled
overviewFields.value: With just a tap on your Klipsch Connect app (available for free in the app store), you can custom EQ settings for your ideal bass, mid-range, and treble, receive over-the-air firmware updates, and receive access to support.

description:
Open-box Focal Bathys have been tested and inspected by our team. All open-box Focal Bathys are sold in like-new condition.

Focal has taken the design, technology, and materials of industry-leading headphones like the Stellia and Celestee, cut some weight, and added a lot of advanced technology. This is a first for Focal, and a huge step forward for the industry.You’ll experience a balanced and neutral sound that’s faithful to the source, but influenced by Focal’s award-winning approach to dynamics, punchiness, and lively reproduction. Either way, these are probably the headphones you’ll end up using the most. The result is a comfortable, easy-to-use set of headphones that wrings every last bit of quality out of the latest Bluetooth wireless codecs but also gives you the option of an excellent wired experience via USB-C and its built-in DAC. And it will last you all week: 30+ hours of listening on a full charge. Running low? Rapid-charging gives you five extra listening hours in just 15 minutes.

description:
Our Take: ﻿A direct competitor to the Sennheiser HD800S, Focal Clear and Audeze LCD-X, the Hifiman Arya are perfect for anyone that craves an expansive soundstage (not on the level of the HD800S) and a brighter sound signature. Lightweight and comfortable, the Arya are easy to leave on your head all day while you're at the office or at home listening to music. With a recent price drop from $1599 to $1299, the Hifiman Arya Planar Magnetic Headphones will not disappoint.

Arya is the culmination of HifiMan’s work. Never has a company brought this kind of Planar performance at this price point. Fast, wide soundstage and mind-blowing detail make the Arya a must-listen. HifiMan Arya features a driver based on the HE1000 V2 headphones, one of the best drivers on the market in our opinion, which raises the sonic characteristics to a considerably higher level than similarly priced products.

description:
The Meze Audio LIRIC II represents a harmonious blend of industrial design prowess and cutting-edge technological innovation. Designed for the active audiophile who demands both mobility and exceptional sound quality, the LIRIC II offers a refined sound profile that strikes a perfect balance between warmth and clarity. Utilizing the innovative Quarter Wavelength Resonator Mask (QWRM), this headphone effectively attenuates high-frequency peaks above 7kHz, ensuring a listening experience that is both rich and non-fatiguing.

Rooted in the tradition of Maramures craftsmanship, the LIRIC II maintains the iconic design language of its predecessor while introducing a touch of warmth through the use of wood in the ear cups. The chosen material, Macassar ebony, is a dense and aesthetically pleasing hardwood known for its deep brown coloration and intricate golden-brown stripes. Each pair of headphones is unique, with the distinctiveness of Macassar ebony ensuring that every LIRIC II is not just a device for music but a personal statement piece with its own story.
name: Meze Audio LIRIC II Headphones

description:
The Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones set a new standard in noise cancellation technology. With two powerful processors managing eight sophisticated microphones, these headphones offer unparalleled noise cancellation. They adeptly filter out a broad range of high and mid-frequency sounds, including airplane noise and human voices, thanks to Sony's innovative Auto NC Optimizer. This feature continuously adapts to your surroundings and wearing conditions, ensuring the most effective noise cancellation in any environment.

Sony's biggest leap in noise canceling technology is embodied in the WH-1000XM5. The eight-microphone system captures ambient sound with exceptional accuracy, significantly reducing high-frequency noise. The Auto NC Optimizer further refines this capability, dynamically adjusting to external factors, such as atmospheric pressure, to provide an optimized listening experience.
name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones

The Denon AH-D7200 represents the pinnacle of headphone engineering, featuring Japanese-crafted FreeEdge 50mm drivers housed in elegant American walnut enclosures and paired with premium cabling. These elements work in harmony to deliver pristine audio reproduction through precise driver movement, resulting in exceptional accuracy and minimal distortion. With Hi-Res Audio certification, these headphones are engineered for listeners who demand the absolute best.

Drawing on over five decades of audio expertise and meticulous craftsmanship, the Denon AH-D7200 stands as a testament to acoustic excellence. These premium headphones deliver crystalline clarity and true-to-source fidelity that will satisfy the most demanding audiophile's quest for sonic perfection.
name: Denon AH-D7200 Headphones

description:
Great loudspeakers disappear, leaving just the music. LS50 Meta is such a loudspeaker. The incredibly immersive sound means you lose yourself in your favourite music. Savouring every nuance as layer upon layer of instrumentation is delivered with exceptional acoustic accuracy anywhere in the room.

A truly revolutionary tool in the KEF acoustic armoury, Metamaterial Absorption Technology ( MAT™) is a highly complex maze-like structure that absorbs 99% of the unwanted sound from the rear of the driver, eliminating the resulting distortion and providing purer, more natural sound.

description:
Our Take: The Kanto TUK Powered Bookshelf Speakers are Kanto's flagship speakers and with good reason. Using Class-D technology, the Kanto TuK delivers a rich, full sound with strong low-end impact and wonderful treble response through it's AMT tweeter. In addition, the Kanto TUK features a plethora of connectivity making it a versatile beast in your home audio set-up. You can even pair them directly with a turntable!

The AMT (Air Motion Transformer) tweeters are designed to deliver bright, accurate highs for an enhanced soundstage, regardless of your position in the room. Further, the high rigidity and low mass of the aluminum drivers allow them to operate efficiently while reducing distortion for clarity at nearly any volume.
name: Kanto TUK Powered Bookshelf Speakers
